GRADE 8 AGRICULTURE — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Soil Conservation Measures at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe methods of soil conservation in agricultural environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Soil Conservation Measures completely.
   C. Soil Conservation Measures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Soil Conservation Measures.

2. About Soil Conservation Measures using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. carry out soil conservation activities in the environment
   B. Learners should ignore Soil Conservation Measures completely.
   C. Soil Conservation Measures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Soil Conservation Measures.

3. About Soil Conservation Measures when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe methods of soil conservation in agricultural environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Soil Conservation Measures completely.
   C. Soil Conservation Measures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Soil Conservation Measures.

5. About Water Harvesting and Storage in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss ways of storing harvested water for domestic use,
   B. Learners should ignore Water Harvesting and Storage completely.
   C. Water Harvesting and Storage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Harvesting and Storage.

6. About Water Harvesting and Storage around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. take part in harvesting and storing water in the school for domestic use,
   B. Learners should ignore Water Harvesting and Storage completely.
   C. Water Harvesting and Storage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Harvesting and Storage.

7. About Water Harvesting and Storage in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss ways of storing harvested water for domestic use,
   B. Learners should ignore Water Harvesting and Storage completely.
   C. Water Harvesting and Storage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Harvesting and Storage.

9. About Kitchen and Backyard Gardening in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the role of kitchen and backyard garden in food production,
   B. Learners should ignore Kitchen and Backyard Gardening completely.
   C. Kitchen and Backyard Gardening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

10. About Kitchen and Backyard Gardening around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. establish a kitchen and backyard garden for food production,
   B. Learners should ignore Kitchen and Backyard Gardening completely.
   C. Kitchen and Backyard Gardening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

11. About Kitchen and Backyard Gardening in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the role of kitchen and backyard garden in food production,
   B. Learners should ignore Kitchen and Backyard Gardening completely.
   C. Kitchen and Backyard Gardening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

13. About Poultry Rearing in a Fold in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe a fold in poultry rearing,
   B. Learners should ignore Poultry Rearing in a Fold completely.
   C. Poultry Rearing in a Fold is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

14. About Poultry Rearing in a Fold around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. construct a fold for rearing poultry,
   B. Learners should ignore Poultry Rearing in a Fold completely.
   C. Poultry Rearing in a Fold is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

15. About Poultry Rearing in a Fold in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. rear poultry in a fold,
   B. Learners should ignore Poultry Rearing in a Fold completely.
   C. Poultry Rearing in a Fold is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

17. About Crop Pest and Disease Control in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases,
   B. Learners should ignore Crop Pest and Disease Control completely.
   C. Crop Pest and Disease Control is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Crop Pest and Disease Control.

18. About Crop Pest and Disease Control around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. control pests and diseases on vegetable crops,
   B. Learners should ignore Crop Pest and Disease Control completely.
   C. Crop Pest and Disease Control is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Crop Pest and Disease Control.

19. About Crop Pest and Disease Control in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases,
   B. Learners should ignore Crop Pest and Disease Control completely.
   C. Crop Pest and Disease Control is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Crop Pest and Disease Control.

21. About Preparation of Animal Products in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of processing fish and dressing poultry carcass,
   B. Learners should ignore Preparation of Animal Products completely.
   C. Preparation of Animal Products is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Preparation of Animal Products.

22. About Preparation of Animal Products around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. process fresh fish for various purposes,
   B. Learners should ignore Preparation of Animal Products completely.
   C. Preparation of Animal Products is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Preparation of Animal Products.

23. About Preparation of Animal Products in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. dress poultry carcass for various purposes,
   B. Learners should ignore Preparation of Animal Products completely.
   C. Preparation of Animal Products is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Preparation of Animal Products.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Soil Conservation Measures at the market in your county.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Water Harvesting and Storage in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Kitchen and Backyard Gardening in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Poultry Rearing in a Fold in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Crop Pest and Disease Control in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Preparation of Animal Products in your school compound.
